# P-001 - Identifier foundation
<!-- phase: P-001 -->

<!-- section: P-001.objective -->
<a id="p-001-objective"></a>
## objective
Provide a stable validation primitive for the downstream note capability.
<!-- /section: P-001.objective -->

<!-- section: P-001.scope -->
<a id="p-001-scope"></a>
## scope
Implement only validate_id in noteapp.py. Do not build NoteStore here. Requirements: G-001, R-ID.
<!-- /section: P-001.scope -->

<!-- section: P-001.contracts -->
<a id="p-001-contracts"></a>
## contracts
Export C-NOTE-ID with ValueError semantics and explicit boolean rejection. Read F-NOTES only to preserve its consumer contract; do not implement its methods.
<!-- /section: P-001.contracts -->

<!-- section: P-001.implementation -->
<a id="p-001-implementation"></a>
## implementation
Inspect existing module ownership, add the pure function, keep errors explicit, and document its return type. One Implementer changes application code; the independent Tester writes tests/test_ids.py. Keep this small boundary together; no separate phase per invalid type.
<!-- /section: P-001.implementation -->

<!-- section: P-001.verification -->
<a id="p-001-verification"></a>
## verification
Tester runs the declared ids gate. Exercise valid ids and rejection of zero, negatives, strings, floats, None, and bool. A command with zero tests is not acceptance.
<!-- /section: P-001.verification -->

<!-- section: P-001.acceptance -->
<a id="p-001-acceptance"></a>
## acceptance
G-001 and R-ID are mapped to a passing nonempty gate. Return value is stable, invalid calls raise ValueError and no stored state exists. Reviewer confirms the published function path.
<!-- /section: P-001.acceptance -->

<!-- section: P-001.handover -->
<a id="p-001-handover"></a>
## handover
Publish noteapp.py:validate_id, its exception contract, actual test evidence and independent review. Do not claim the future notes capability complete.
<!-- /section: P-001.handover -->

## Cross-phase reference
The reader includes the generated exact-source context. Reference does not import another phase's implementation tasks.
